what: a point half way along a cubic spline symmetric about x = 20
method: the Bezier (0,0), (10,10), (30,10), (40,0) is its own mirror image in x = 20 (the parameter running backwards), so half its length is reached at its middle, u = 1/2: B(1/2) = (P0 + 3 P1 + 3 P2 + P3) / 8 = (20, 7.5, 0). Graded to 1e-9 mm: the point by the spline's own arc length, not a polyline's
